title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in Rwanda, nationally, contributes to outcome 2.1 Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic wellbeing. The objective is that people living in poverty collaborate in advocacy initiatives for their rights. Activities will focus on local and national level dialogues, supporting evidence-based climate change advocacy at national/regional/international levels; participation in national/regional climate networks, and other preparations for participation in major climate events e.g. COP. The programme is in partnership with BIOCOOR and RCCDN. Note: other partners may be included. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:Supporting communities to• establish themselves as recognised authorities for rehabilitation, protection and management or co-management (with local and national authorities) of their common resources including water, forest, wetlands ecosystems.• To track local government budgets for governance and management of natural resources• To implement evidence-based environmental and climate change advocacy; supporting local voices to advocate for the protection of their natural resources; influencing national and international policy and decision makers on food, agriculture, climate and environmental justice policies and strategies at local and national levels. Examples include rights to diverse seeds, access to services, land, water and wildlife.• Climate adaptation is linked to biodiversity because by protecting and restoring biodiversity, we strengthen the resilience of our ecosystems and the communities we work with to the impacts of climate change• Policy work at national and international level on climate finance, support for Agroecology and promotion of renewables are directly linked to climate mitigationSupporting women and women centred organisations to• To form their own structures and gain skills to participate in food rights, seed rights, environmental and climate networks and advocacy groups.
